exact_result: For every reduced irreducible geometrically unibranch projective variety X over an algebraically closed trivially valued characteristic-zero field k, and every ample line bundle L or ample real numerical Cartier class omega, the genuine finite-energy mixed Monge-Ampere operator has the model intersection normalization, diagonal raw mass V=(omega^n), and a raw target nu of mass V is solvable by an E1 potential iff E_dual(nu/V) is finite. The solution is unique modulo one real constant. Envelopes, normalized psh compactness, two-sided energy differentiation, bounded-J target integration, finite-energy comparison/domination and I-completeness are established in this retained domain, using the supplied exact BJ and Wu source theorems. There is no countability or skeletal support restriction. Natural degree-one normalization descent is proved, and a genuine finite-energy nonsolvable nodal-curve target bounds the singular extension. This does not assert results on the other mathematical axes or independent certification/novelty of the sources.
